component.name: trebaruna
component.summary: Sign and check documents with the European signature formats
Firma y comprueba documentos con los formatos de firma europeos
Signa i comprova documents amb els formats de signatura europeus
Asina e comproba documentos cos formatos de sinatura europeos
Sinatu eta egiaztatu dokumentuak Europako sinadura-formatuekin
Firma e verifica documenti con i formati di firma europei

description.p: trebaruna signs PDF, XML and any other file with a certificate on a file, a smart card, Firefox or a remote signing service, and checks signatures against the European trust lists. It replaces AutoFirma, and answers the afirma:// requests of public administration websites.

ul.li: PAdES, CAdES, XAdES, XMLDSig, ASiC, OpenDocument and Office Open XML signatures
Timestamps, long-term validation and archival levels
A visible seal you place on the page, with an optional handwritten signature
Every network connection it makes is listed in the result

description.p: Web pages that speak AutoFirma's protocol can have an ASiC container co-signed.
A PDF whose signature envelope carries other content is left to the PDF library's verdict.
PDF timestamps from authorities that sign with RSA-PSS are checked against the document.
The window signs with a key kept by a remote signing service.
Remote signatures can be authorised in the browser, through the provider's OAuth2 server.
A remote signature asks the provider for the credential once.
The window encrypts documents for others and opens encrypted envelopes.
The Flatpak signs with smart cards.
The window follows the desktop's light or dark preference.
Timestamps an authority signed with RSA-PSS are read as valid.
ASiC containers are co-signed.
ASiC time-stamped containers are made and verified.
XML signatures declare where they were made, and web page approvals show the policy, roles and place a signature will declare.
Verification shows the policy, the roles and the place a signature declares.
Web pages sign single documents through the site's server (the …tri formats).
XAdES signatures are counter-signed inside the document, from the command line and from web pages.
Signatures added to a CAdES envelope take levels LT and LTA.
CAdES-LTA archive timestamps follow EN 319 122-1 and are checked by verification.
The window and web pages sign a PDF form in its signature field; trebaruna fields lists a form's empty fields.
PDF signatures declare a signature policy, such as the AGE's, from the command line and from web pages.
A PAdES B-LT signature added to a signed PDF keys its revocation entry to itself.
A PDF form is signed in its empty signature field, the seal drawn in the field's box.
The seal is laid out apart from the PDF library that draws it.
CMS and PDF signatures made with RSA-PSS are verified, and chains reach German authorities with RSA-PSS keys.
Trusted lists download from servers that refuse unnamed clients, and the EU list is read once per sync.
XML signatures made with RSA-PSS or SHA-3 are verified; the German trusted list authenticates.
A trusted list is used only when its own signature signs the whole list.
Verification names the parts of an XML document a signature leaves out.
Verification checks the XAdES archive timestamp imprint.
Verification checks the signing-certificate binding.
Accessibility: contrast, keyboard resizing of the seal, names for screen readers.
The page preview works without poppler.
Packages: .deb, Flatpak, AppImage and a Windows installer.
